bibl.title: Identification of some winners in the keles race in Posidippus' epigrams.
bibl.seg: Filippo Canali De Rossi, Identification of some winners in the keles race in Posidippus' epigrams.
Jean-Charles Moretti & Panos Valavanis (edd.), Les hippodromes et les concours hippiques dans la Grèce antique = BCH. Supplément 62 (Athènes, 2019) pp. 335-340.
bibl.note: Through an examination of epigrams concerning the race for single horses in the Hippikà section of the Milan Papyrus Vogliano VIII 309, develops the hypothesis that these epinician epigrams did not celebrate contemporary victories (such as those for the Ptolemies), but instead, historical winners of the past. - Posidippus' epigram 83 (P. Mil. Vogl. VIII, 309, XIII 15-18). - Epigram 71 (P. Mil. Vogl. VIII, 309, XI 21-24). - Epigram 86 (P. Mil. Vogl. VIII, 309, XIII 27-30). - Conclusion.
